subject: You are in charge this week
body:
I am out for seven days. You run the camp now.

Read every booking, assign people manually, and do not let cabins stay dirty.

subject: First day check
body:
Good luck on your first day.

If inbox starts screaming, breathe and sort by customer mail first.

body:
